query: INSERT INTO artists (source, source_artist_id, name, name_key, key) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?2) ON CONFLICT(source, source_artist_id) DO UPDATE SET name = CASE WHEN artists.named_by_source = 1 THEN artists.name ELSE ?3 END, name_key = CASE WHEN artists.named_by_source = 1 THEN artists.name_key ELSE ?4 END RETURNING id AS "id!: i64"
